title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding the Extended Marketing Mix
description: Embark on a journey to comprehend the intricacies of marketing with our course, "Understanding the Extended Marketing Mix."
longDescription: Understand the Extended Marketing Mix. Explore the Marketing Process and Its Elements. Master Marketing Mix Planning. Identify Types of Business Processes. Comprehend Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). Enhance Consistency in Customer Service through People and Customer Interface. Discover Qualities of an Effective Customer Service Representative. This course provides an in-depth understanding of the Extended Marketing Mix, unraveling the marketing process and its planning elements. Participants will identify various business processes, delve into standard operating procedures (SOP), and enhance customer service consistency through a focus on people and customer interface. courseDetails: Explore the intricacies of the Extended Marketing Mix, covering planning, business processes, and standard operating procedures.
